full_name: Joanne Meyerowitz | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2015–2016 History Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor Yale University
bio: Joanne Meyerowitz is the Arthur Unobskey Professor of History and American Studies at Yale University. Her research focuses on 20th-century US history, with emphases on gender and sexuality.
